ios.desc:
Voola is your personal movie and TV assistant—a home for what you have watched, what you want to watch, and what you should discover next.

Use Voola to:
- Recognize movies, shows and on-screen cast from clips
- Save to Watchlist or Watched, rate titles and create lists
- Import Letterboxd, Trakt and TV Time history
- Get personalized weekly picks and taste insights
- Explore trending, now playing and currently airing titles
- Unlock exact season and episode matching with Premium

Think of clip identification as “Shazam for Movies”: record a clip, choose one from your library, paste a social link or share directly to Voola. Then save the result, see where it streams, rate it and keep your watch life organized.

On iPhone, share clips and links from supported apps and follow background scans on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.

Unlimited core title and cast identification is free. Premium unlocks exact season and episode matching, Describe Search, unlimited link and share scans, background scans, the full My Taste profile and unlimited lists.

Voola Premium is available as weekly or annual auto-renewing subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Manage or cancel in App Store settings. Prices vary by region.

Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://www.ravorian.com/voola-privacy-policy

quotes.text:
It's called Voola.

With just a short video clip from your Camera or Video Library, Voola can identify the title and give you the details you’re looking for in seconds.

The accuracy is pretty crazy.

Available now on the Apple App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/voola-shazam-for-movies-tv/id6737161303
